data.body: Patch set 7 pushed to Gerrit change 2483. It addresses the LLM blocker by making ticket-layout-shards require an explicit typed config/env opt-in (ensure.ticket_layout_shards_cutover / REBAR_ENSURE_TICKET_LAYOUT_SHARDS_CUTOVER=1) before moving existing flat ticket directories; without opt-in it returns failed and leaves the store unchanged, so init/MCP boot cannot silently cut over a live legacy store. Local checks: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS, sharding/heldout/fsck/concurrency pytest set PASS (52 tests), ensure/config-focused pytest set PASS (78 tests), verify-commit-ticket PASS. Awaiting new Verified and LLM-Review. Live cutover sequencing is an operator decision — not performed.
